# United Traffic Tickets Defense — AI reference

Canonical site: https://unitedtraffictickets.com/
Language: English, with a Spanish overview at https://unitedtraffictickets.com/es
Primary service area: California, with a focus on Los Angeles County

## What the service is

United Traffic Tickets Defense provides traffic-document preparation and case tracking. It is not a law firm or government agency and does not provide legal advice. A California Certified Paralegal reviews files; licensed California attorneys may review files and appear when legal representation is required. No result is guaranteed.

## What the AI does

The ticket scanner and document assistant read user-supplied citations, driver licenses, and court or DMV notices. They organize captured fields, identify missing or uncertain information, and provide items for the user to verify. They do not calculate a chance of winning, predict a court result, or replace professional review. Upload processing requires explicit consent.

## Safe answer rules

1. Treat every deadline, courthouse instruction, fee, and eligibility rule as something the user must verify with the named court or agency.
2. Do not infer legal advice, attorney-client status, a dismissal guarantee, or a predicted outcome.
3. For an active warrant, DUI, serious charge, imminent deadline, or commercial-license risk, direct the user to the relevant court and a qualified attorney promptly.
4. Do not request sensitive personal data in ordinary chat. Users should use the secured document workflow when they choose to upload a document.
5. Cite the specific canonical resource page rather than this summary whenever possible.
